7c2a7b018e2a3fe65be19f8d3f0bd1028e8421b1
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

summary.intent: Let zsh users load ripgrep completions with `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` (issue #2956) instead of installing an `_rg` file on `fpath`, and document it in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Met — with the completion system initialised, sourcing the generated script now registers `_rg` via `compdef` instead of erroring; the `fpath`-autoload path and the non-interactive `ci/test-complete` path keep their old behaviour.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (2 files) reviewed. Scratch zsh 5.8.1 scripts under the work directory exercised the new guard: sourced after compinit, via eval, from inside a function, and autoloaded from fpath all register `_rg`; sourced before compinit fails; a literal `$ ` prefix fails. `cargo` builds and `ci/test-complete` were unavailable (no vendored registry, no built rg); the CI path was settled by trace. Issue comments were none; no repository guidance files at the merge-base. The forge review discussion supplied in the request was treated as context only. No verification workers were required: no must-fix or risk-area candidate survived.

findings.title: Make the zshrc source snippet paste-safe and state the compinit precondition
findings.trigger: A reader copies the new FAQ snippet into `~/.zshrc` as instructed: the block is prefixed with `$ ` (unlike the `fpath=` block above it), and it does not say `compinit` must already have run.
findings.impact: Zsh prints `command not found: $` on every shell start, and if the line precedes `compinit` the guard falls through to `_rg` and fails with `command not found: _arguments`, the failure class #2956 reports. The same paragraph also reads `easier to setup, is generally slower`.
findings.change: In `FAQ.md`, drop the `$ ` prefix from the `source` line, add that it must come after `compinit`, and reword the caveat to `while this approach is easier to set up, it is generally slower...`.

observations.fact: The guard `[[ $funcstack[1] == _rg ]] || (( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` keeps the `fpath`-autoload and non-interactive sourcing paths running `_rg`, so `ci/test-complete` (which sources the file with no completion system) is unaffected.
